name: bu_Si6N8
title: Si3N4 (Si6N8) crystal
description: Crystal structure prediction of Si3N4 with 2 formula units (14 atoms) per cell, the primitive cell of both the experimental ground state beta-Si3N4 (P6_3/m) and spinel gamma-Si3N4. The putative NEP89 global minimum is not beta-Si3N4 but a hypothetical, chemically sensible network (tetrahedral Si, 3-coordinated but pyramidal N, no homopolar bonds) 12 meV/atom below beta-Si3N4 and 7% denser. Artefact screening: NEP89 has two collapsed holes, an N-N bonded phase (N-N 1.10-1.14 A, Si-Si 1.97 A, 28.5 eV below the physical minimum) and a dense phase with Si-Si 1.65 A (5.2 eV below), both found by symmetry-constrained random search. Guard factor 0.90 (Si-Si >= 2.0 A, Si-N >= 1.64 A) plus an N-N floor of 1.9 A remove both (re-relaxed >= 8.7 eV above the minimum); the physical minima (Si-N >= 1.68 A, N-N >= 2.7 A) are unchanged.
